step: M8c round-3 family fixes (findings 1, 5, 6): proof summary

finding_1_usage_snapshot_and_sweep.origin: Pre-existing in the 18.16.0 family, carried through the 18.18.0 rewrite; not introduced by it. In the 18.16.0 family tree (/tmp/omp-plan-18180/rebase/old-work) pi-tui status-line/component.ts:2109-2128 already scoped the fetch to the active provider (host.fetchUsageReports(session, signal, provider)), status-line-host.ts:59-60 forwarded it, and AgentSession.fetchUsageReports(signal, provider) (agent-session.ts:14969-14993) assigned the scoped result to #usageReports and passed it to #maybeScheduleResetSweep. Pristine 18.16.0/18.18.0 only ever received the unscoped call. The 18.18.0 rewrite only turned the singular provider into a provider set (statusLineHost: provider ? [provider] : undefined), same behaviour.
finding_1_usage_snapshot_and_sweep.fix: AgentSession.fetchUsageReports merges a scoped result into the cached snapshot (only the scoped providers' rows are replaced; an unscoped fetch still replaces everything; an explicit empty set refreshes and sweeps nothing). #maybeScheduleResetSweep(snapshot, scope) treats providers outside the scope as candidates and, inside the sweep, fetches exactly those into the shared snapshot before planning (#completeUsageSnapshot, 10 s timeout, cached by the usage service), so Codex/Claude salvage is evaluated from any single-provider session; statusline polling stays scoped (no change to component.ts/status-line-host.ts).
finding_1_usage_snapshot_and_sweep.owner: 0095 (agent-session.ts, already the last owner carrying the fetchUsageReports provider-set hunk); harness amend refuses a shared-path amend into an earlier owner.
finding_1_usage_snapshot_and_sweep.gate: verify-usage-thread-providers.ts consumer leg (real AgentSession, stub usage.reports/oauth.accounts/listResetCredits); worker-runtime-probe usageSessionOpen disables the sweep so the worker-set leg keeps observing only the caller's sets.

finding_5_request_purpose.fix: StreamOptions.requestPurpose ("main"|"side"), forwarded by mapOptionsForApi (stream.ts); the Anthropic audit classifies sideRequest = requestPurpose !== "main", no longer from statefulResponses/initiatorOverride. The one main-loop producer, the sdk.ts session streamFn, marks requestPurpose "main" on the request it sends (not on `merged`, so the warmer replay built from it stays unmarked). Every other same-session producer (local summaries, warmers, edit auto-repair, memory jobs, sharpshooter, title/commit generators, advisors, ephemeral side turns) is side by default, so an unmarked oneshot can never replace the baseline.
finding_5_request_purpose.owners: 0094 (anthropic.ts, types.ts, dist types.d.ts), family-devin-wire (stream.ts, sole owner), 0095 (sdk.ts)
finding_5_request_purpose.gate: verify-anthropic-request-audit.ts: stateless main turn establishes/advances the baseline, unmarked stateless request is side, compressed explicit-side and unmarked same-model requests leave the baseline untouched, real AgentSession main turn carries requestPurpose main and a real ephemeral side turn does not; verify-anthropic-threads-cache-shape.ts marks its main sends.

finding_6_wire_bytes.fix: The audit gains wrapWire installed beneath the compressor (AnthropicClientOptionsArgs.wrapWireFetch); meta.wire.bytes is the encoded body length handed to the transport (gzip length), meta.wire.encoding its content-encoding, meta.wire.logicalBytes the pre-compression length, meta.wire.sends the number of sends (a compression-fallback resend rewrites the record atomically). A request that never reaches the wire wrapper is recorded without a bytes claim.
finding_6_wire_bytes.gate: verify-anthropic-request-audit.ts compression leg asserts meta.wire.bytes === the real gzip Uint8Array length, < logical length, logicalBytes, encoding, sends; verify-anthropic-threads-cache-shape.ts record-safety installs the wire wrapper.
